name: Stone rubble
description: A heap of fallen dressed masonry about 1.2 m across and 0.6 m high: dark blue-grey ashlar blocks and a coping slab tumbled and stacked on a low mound of grit, some broken with paler fresh faces, with chips and grit spilled round the foot.
